comments.author: david-gpu
comments.story: Why did we wait so long for the bicycle? (2019)
comments.why: Bikes self-balance by steering into the lean, no gyroscope needed
comments.text: The gyroscopic effect is not necessary, and it has been demonstrated both in reality and in simulation [0]. The central principle behind why a bicycle is self balancing while in motion is the fact that it self-steers in the same direction that it is leaning, which counteracts the fall [0][1]. comments.author: ehnto
comments.text: You can't turn a bicycle or motorbike without counter-steering, so these people are just not turning their bikes? It's not possible to not countersteer as the bike would lean to the wrong direction and you'd turn the wrong way (since you'd have been initiating a countersteer, afterall). Are you seeing people just manhandle the bars the wrong way in emergencies? I could believe that. [VIDEO]

comments.text: Most people would be surprised, but I’m happy to assert most of the things we do with an expectation of causal effect are superstitions.
